messages.content: You help a home robot keep track of where household things are. Read the robot's notes and answer with JSON only.

The robot walked through every room on day 0 at 18:00 and since then patrols every room every 0 hours, listing what is on every spot and who is in the room. Pockets and bags are not looked into.

Residents:
- Felix (in their thirties) works in an office in town. Every day: out at work from about 8 in the morning to 5:30, then home for the evening. Hobbies: calls with family, knitting, movies.
- Aisha (in their forties) works in an office in town. Every day: out at work from about 8 in the morning to 5:30, then home for the evening. Hobbies: calls with family, movies, houseplants, running.

Rooms and spots:
- balcony: balcony_floor_y1, balcony_table_y1
- bathroom: bathroom_shelf_ba1, medicine_cabinet_ba1, sink_ba_ba1, towel_rack_ba1
- bedroom_1: bed_b1, bedroom_floor_b1, desk_b1, dresser_b1, nightstand_b1, wardrobe_b1
- entry: entry_floor_e1, entry_hook_e1, entry_table_e1, shoe_rack_e1
- kitchen: chair_k1, counter_k1, cupboard_k1, dish_rack_k1, drawer_k_k1, floor_k_k1, kitchen_table_k1, pantry_shelf_k1, sink_k1
- living: armchair_l1, bookshelf_l1, coffee_table_l1, couch_l1, floor_l_l1, side_table_l1, tv_stand_l1
- office: desk_o1, floor_o_o1, office_chair_o1, office_shelf_o1

Answer options: a spot name from the list above; ON_PERSON:<name> if a resident is carrying it; OUT_OF_HOUSE if it has been taken out of the home; ABSTAIN if you would rather not guess.

Now: day 4, 23:59 (day 4 of the study; the walkthrough was on day 0 evening).

It is the end of day 4.
You maintain a temporal knowledge graph. For each NEW fact decide whether it DUPLICATES an old current fact (give its id) or is ADDed. For each OLD current fact that a new fact contradicts (the object can no longer be at that spot in those hours), choose INVALIDATE: the old fact is kept, but its validity period ends today. Old facts not mentioned stay current.

The robot walked through every room on day 0 at 18:00 and since then patrols every room every 0 hours, listing what is on every spot and who is in the room. Pockets and bags are not looked into.

- Felix (in their thirties) works in an office in town. Every day: out at work from about 8 in the morning to 5:30, then home for the evening. Hobbies: calls with family, knitting, movies.
- Aisha (in their forties) works in an office in town. Every day: out at work from about 8 in the morning to 5:30, then home for the evening. Hobbies: calls with family, movies, houseplants, running.

Rooms and spots:
- balcony: balcony_floor_y1, balcony_table_y1
- bathroom: bathroom_shelf_ba1, medicine_cabinet_ba1, sink_ba_ba1, towel_rack_ba1
- bedroom_1: bed_b1, bedroom_floor_b1, desk_b1, dresser_b1, nightstand_b1, wardrobe_b1
- entry: entry_floor_e1, entry_hook_e1, entry_table_e1, shoe_rack_e1
- kitchen: chair_k1, counter_k1, cupboard_k1, dish_rack_k1, drawer_k_k1, floor_k_k1, kitchen_table_k1, pantry_shelf_k1, sink_k1
- living: armchair_l1, bookshelf_l1, coffee_table_l1, couch_l1, floor_l_l1, side_table_l1, tv_stand_l1
- office: desk_o1, floor_o_o1, office_chair_o1, office_shelf_o1

Answer options: a spot name from the list above; ON_PERSON:<name> if a resident is carrying it; OUT_OF_HOUSE if it has been taken out of the home; ABSTAIN if you would rather not guess.

Now: day 7, 23:59 (day 7 of the study; the walkthrough was on day 0 evening).

It is the end of day 7.
You maintain a temporal knowledge graph. For each NEW fact decide whether it DUPLICATES an old current fact (give its id) or is ADDed. For each OLD current fact that a new fact contradicts (the object can no longer be at that spot in those hours), choose INVALIDATE: the old fact is kept, but its validity period ends today. Old facts not mentioned stay current.

messages.content: You help a home robot keep track of where household things are. Read the robot's notes and answer with JSON only.

The robot walked through every room on day 0 at 18:00 and since then patrols every room every 0 hours, listing what is on every spot and who is in the room. Pockets and bags are not looked into.

Residents:
- Felix (in their thirties) works in an office in town. Every day: out at work from about 8 in the morning to 5:30, then home for the evening. Hobbies: calls with family, knitting, movies.
- Aisha (in their forties) works in an office in town. Every day: out at work from about 8 in the morning to 5:30, then home for the evening. Hobbies: calls with family, movies, houseplants, running.

Rooms and spots:
- balcony: balcony_floor_y1, balcony_table_y1
- bathroom: bathroom_shelf_ba1, medicine_cabinet_ba1, sink_ba_ba1, towel_rack_ba1
- bedroom_1: bed_b1, bedroom_floor_b1, desk_b1, dresser_b1, nightstand_b1, wardrobe_b1
- entry: entry_floor_e1, entry_hook_e1, entry_table_e1, shoe_rack_e1
- kitchen: chair_k1, counter_k1, cupboard_k1, dish_rack_k1, drawer_k_k1, floor_k_k1, kitchen_table_k1, pantry_shelf_k1, sink_k1
- living: armchair_l1, bookshelf_l1, coffee_table_l1, couch_l1, floor_l_l1, side_table_l1, tv_stand_l1
- office: desk_o1, floor_o_o1, office_chair_o1, office_shelf_o1

Answer options: a spot name from the list above; ON_PERSON:<name> if a resident is carrying it; OUT_OF_HOUSE if it has been taken out of the home; ABSTAIN if you would rather not guess.

Now: day 8, 23:59 (day 8 of the study; the walkthrough was on day 0 evening).

It is the end of day 8.
You maintain a temporal knowledge graph. For each NEW fact decide whether it DUPLICATES an old current fact (give its id) or is ADDed. For each OLD current fact that a new fact contradicts (the object can no longer be at that spot in those hours), choose INVALIDATE: the old fact is kept, but its validity period ends today. Old facts not mentioned stay current.

Answer options: a spot name from the list above; ON_PERSON:<name> if a resident is carrying it; OUT_OF_HOUSE if it has been taken out of the home; ABSTAIN if you would rather not guess.

For each OLD current fact that a new fact contradicts (the object can no longer be at that spot in those hours), choose INVALIDATE: the old fact is kept, but its validity period ends today. Old facts not mentioned stay current.
